note: Generated by design/tools/arena.py. GAME_DESIGN 9: six structures (the mini-bosses' Pen is the seventh, in design/bosses/minibosses.json) and eight events.

common.note: World units. A structure stands in the world for one Track; an event is a few bars long. Both are placed by the run's seed relative to the players' centre at the moment they are placed, never inside a player's frame, never within 400 wu of a wall, and never while a boss or a mini-boss is alive. Health and damage follow the Track through 'trackScale': the mini-boss health of that Track in design/bosses/minibosses.json (Track 1 uses 300), times the fraction given.
common.structuresPlaced: on the first downbeat of the Track, 1,000 to 1,800 wu from the players' centre, at least 700 wu from each other; the last Track's dissolve over the Track change's Break unless a player is within 600 wu, in which case they stay until that player leaves
common.events: Track 1 has one, the Comet, in the Groove of its third cycle; from Track 2 one event a Track, in the Groove of its second cycle; from Track 4 a second one in the Groove of its third cycle. Drawn by the seed from the Track's list, never the event of the Track before. Announced one bar ahead by a gold edge chevron and its name as world text at the place (cap 22, gold), then it runs
common.indicators: structures get no edge chevron (they are found); events get the gold one; a Rift's is the enemy hue with a ring at its tip
common.coop: placed round the players' centre; every reward is for each player (Boost orbs and Shards are each player's own, as everywhere)
common.caps: at most 6 structures and 1 event alive; what an event or a structure spawns counts against the enemy and bullet caps

structures.name: Vault
structures.what: an armoured crystal: break it for a Boost and Shards
rules: health: trackScale x 0.33
takes damage from shots, Riffs and Novas; nothing else touches it; it does not hurt
each quarter of its health lost, one ring of its ornament shatters and it rings one step higher
broken: one Boost orb and 40 Shards for each player
structures.look: three nested hexagons in white and gold with a glass fill and a gold pool at 0.2; it turns a twelfth of a turn a bar and swells 6% on the kick
structures.sound: each hit a glass tick on a note of the scale, one step up for each quarter lost; the break an arpeggio of bells up the chord with a glass burst

structures.name: Pylon
structures.what: a turret you tune by standing still
rules: its ring is 150 wu, dashed in the palette accent: stand inside for four beats and it fills clockwise; leave and it empties twice as fast
tuned, it takes the tuner's colour and on the One of every bar fires a ring that runs to 520 wu at 700 wu/s and deals 6 x the Track's number to each enemy once
it stays tuned for one cycle (36 bars; 24 in Track 1), then dims and can be tuned again; enemies ignore it
structures.look: a tall diamond with a white spine and four white ticks; untuned at 0.8 in the accent, tuned at 2.4 in the player's colours with a pool at 0.15; its pulse is a Riff ring in that player's colours (rings are a language: look.md 6)
structures.sound: the fill is a woodblock on each of the four beats, rising; tuned is three bells up the chord; each pulse a bell on the chord's root an octave up, on the One

structures.name: Rift
structures.what: a tear the crowd comes through: close it
rules: opens with the Groove of the Track's second cycle and stays through the Build; at the Drop it closes by itself and gives nothing
while open, four of the Track's fodder come through it every bar (they are part of the crowd target, not on top of it)
health: trackScale x 0.25; destroyed: the flow stops, one Boost orb and 30 Shards for each player
structures.look: three broken rings in the first enemy hue turning against each other, a black disc inside (the only filled black in the game: the lattice is pulled 20 wu into it) and sparks spiralling in; off screen its chevron carries a ring
structures.sound: a drone on the chord's bass note while it is open, its cutoff rising through the Build; a tom for each body that comes through; destroyed: a reversed cymbal cut short, then glass

structures.name: Bumper
structures.what: it bounces everything, and it is tuned
rules: ships bounce off it unhurt with a kick of 600 wu/s; player shots reflect off it (a free bounce, and x 1.5 damage afterwards); enemies and their bullets bounce too
every player shot that hits it charges it; at eight it discharges on the next beat: a ring to 260 wu dealing 10 x the Track's number to enemies
a Track that has Bumpers has three or four, 300 to 500 wu apart: a cluster to play in
structures.look: a ring with a smaller ring inside and four white ticks; its fill brightens with its charge (glass 0.05 to 0.4) and the discharge is a white shock ring
structures.sound: each Bumper of a cluster owns a chord tone (root, third, fifth, octave): a bounce is a tom on its note, so a shot rattling between them plays the chord; the discharge is the chord's stab with a zap

structures.name: Current
structures.what: a lane that carries whatever enters it
rules: a lane 240 wu wide and 1,600 long; anything inside moves 260 wu/s faster along it: ships, enemies, enemy bullets
player shots travelling with it are 30% faster and deal 30% more; against it, 30% slower and no less
a Track that has Currents has two, crossing
structures.look: no walls: rows of chevrons in the palette's grid colour at 0.6 streaming along it on the eighths, and the lattice inside it stretched 12 wu downstream
structures.sound: a whoosh that is heard only inside, panned along the flow; entering it is a short upward sweep

structures.name: Lens
structures.what: a bar of glass that splits your shots in three
rules: a line 320 wu long; a player shot crossing it becomes three: the middle keeps its damage, the two beside it fan 14 degrees out at half damage
ships, enemies and enemy bullets pass through it untouched; it cannot be hurt; a shot is split once by each Lens
the split shots take the hues 60 degrees either side of the player's, as Prism's lanes do
structures.look: a thin lozenge of white glass with a bright spine; it turns slowly, one turn every eight bars, so the fan sweeps
structures.sound: each split is a glass tick a fifth above the lead's note
structures.note: GAME_DESIGN 9 called this structure 'Prism'; it is the Lens here so that it is not confused with the Boost of that name

events.name: Vault Drop
events.what: a rich Vault that will not wait
rules: a gold Vault warps in 1,000 to 1,400 wu from the players' centre under a column of light
health trackScale x 0.4; broken: two Boost orbs and 80 Shards for each player
a ring round it empties over eight bars; then it warps out
events.look: the Vault in gold with a flare 400 px tall for its first bar and a thin timer ring at 90 wu
events.sound: it lands with the gong; its ring ticks a woodblock on each bar line, faster in the last bar

events.name: Rift Surge
rules: at the start of a Build three Rifts open on a triangle 900 wu from the players' centre, each letting six through a bar
they close at the end of the Drop
each one destroyed pays as a Rift; all three: a Cell for each hurt player, 100 Shards for the others
events.look: as the Rift; the three are joined by a faint triangle of their hue until one is closed
events.sound: three drones a fifth apart; each closing takes its note away

events.name: Elite Hunt
rules: one elite of the Track's highest-threat family warps in 1,200 wu away carrying two traits (three from Track 7) and flees the nearest player at 0.8 of its speed
killed within twelve bars: a Trio for each player (as a level's) and 150 Shards; otherwise it warps out
events.look: the elite's own look with a white edge chevron; a dotted white line trails it for a bar so that it can be followed
events.sound: the elite's arrival fifth, then its family's own voice receding; the kill is the upgrade chord

events.name: Comet
events.what: a neutral body crossing the arena, trailing Shards
rules: it crosses on a straight line passing within 300 wu of the players' centre at 700 wu/s and leaves five Shards a beat behind it
health trackScale x 0.1; broken: 60 Shards and one Boost orb for each player
it hurts nothing and nothing but player fire hurts it
events.look: a white kite with a three-line tail in gold fading over 200 wu, a sparkle at its head
events.sound: a saw glide rising over the two beats of its warning, then a bell on each Shard it drops; no name card, it is too fast: a white chevron two beats ahead

events.name: Eclipse
events.what: lights out: the crowd is seen on the beat
rules: for eight bars the scene falls dark and comes back for a flash on every beat (the kick's envelope, 110 ms)
the priority layer never dims: every bullet, beam and ship is as bright as ever
kills score double while it lasts
events.look: scene light x 0.15 between beats (enemy lines, effects, lattice heat), the lattice at 0.05, the background off; players' own light is untouched; a dark ring sweeps across the frame as it begins and ends. Reduce flashing: x 0.4 between beats and the flash adds 0.3
events.sound: the music bus low-passed at 1.2 kHz for the eight bars; a soft tick on each flash

events.name: Meteor Rain
events.what: impacts on the beat, each one announced
rules: for four bars, on every beat, three dashed danger rings of 110 wu appear in the frame, one of them where a player stands
two beats later, on the beat, each one lands: a cell from any ship inside, 20 x the Track's number to every enemy inside
events.look: the ring fills from its edge to its centre over the two beats, on the priority layer; the impact is a large kill in white with a hot lattice dent
events.sound: each warning is a saw glide falling over its two beats; each impact the sub drop and a crash, on the beat

events.name: Convoy
events.what: slow carriers with heavy loot, and an escort
rules: three carriers cross in a line at 60 wu/s, starting 1,500 wu from the players' centre, with eight Hounds of the Track's tier round them
each carrier: health trackScale x 0.33; one Boost orb and 50 Shards for each player; the last of the three also drops a Cell
after twelve bars whatever is left warps out
events.look: the carrier: an octagon in gold with a white hold and a plus, radius 44, a gold pool; the three joined by a thin gold line
events.sound: a low tom on every beat while they roll, one voice a carrier; each one broken is the Boost bells

events.name: Storm Cell
events.what: a field of lightning that roams: a weapon if you lead the crowd into it
rules: a circle of 320 wu drifting toward the players' centre at 90 wu/s for eight bars
on every beat lightning joins up to six bodies inside it: 15 x the Track's number to each enemy
a ship inside on a beat is warned (its halo crackles); still inside on the next beat it loses a cell
events.look: a ring in the palette accent with the lattice hot inside it; the strikes are zigzag lines drawn for one beat in white and the accent
events.sound: a crackle that rises as it nears; each strike a zap on the chord's three notes

byTrack.note: Track 1 has no event before its third cycle (the Comet). In the loop each Track keeps its list.
